title: Glowing planet with rings
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='planet' cx='38%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0592a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ringBack' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7be3ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
      <stop offset='25%' stop-color='#9ff0ff'/>
      <stop offset='75%' stop-color='#c9f7ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7be3ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ringFront' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4fd6f5' stop-opacity='0'/>
      <stop offset='20%' stop-color='#6fe0ff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#e6fcff'/>
      <stop offset='80%' stop-color='#6fe0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4fd6f5' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- back half of ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='46' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='url(#ringBack)' stroke-width='6' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- planet body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='27' fill='url(#planet)'/>

  <!-- glowing bands on planet -->
  <path d='M26 42 Q50 36 74 42' fill='none' stroke='#ffd98a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M25 52 Q50 47 75 52' fill='none' stroke='#ffce6e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M28 62 Q50 58 72 62' fill='none' stroke='#ffb84d' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='4' fill='#fff4c4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='66' r='3' fill='#ffd98a' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- front half of ring, crossing over planet -->
  <path d='M6 54 Q50 74 94 54' fill='none' stroke='url(#ringFront)' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- glow sparkles -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='30' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='36' r='1.5' fill='#d6f9ff'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='80' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='76' r='1.4' fill='#d6f9ff'/>
</svg>
